proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: An authority's signature or 'يعتمد' (approved/authenticated) block on a certificate or licence that the authority itself issued is issuance, not a review decision on a submitted document: decision absent, no_decision_area. A dated stamp in an 'AUTHORITIES APPROVAL' box with no decision wording is ambiguous; its actor is recorded from the stamp text (here the client, inferred), and it is not resolved for scoring.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (g) revision only as suffix / form-code suffixes
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: A revision-like suffix on a form or template code (for example the 'P06/TRANS/R1' footer) is never the document's revision. Only a suffix of the document's own number qualifies under section 4, with association uncertain.

proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: A file holding several distinct documents is one pool document. A field is resolved for scoring only when every in-scope component has the same truth. It carries a fact only when that common truth is present with resolved association. F069 holds two quotations: revision and decision are resolved as absent, and identity is not resolved.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (h2) project/job number printed under a 'Reference' label
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: When the value under a document's 'Reference'/'Ref.' label is the project or job number, the identity is 'ambiguous' (role not established), not 'present', and the number goes to other_identities. The value counts as a project or job number when the same project's staged pages show it as one, or when distinct documents share it verbatim.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (i2) candidate literals split across line breaks
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: A candidate literal must be the whole printed value, with line breaks joined by one space (section 3), never a fragment of one line.
